data_issues: The unit (neuron) columns of the test set are permuted relative to train/val: about 12 of the 29 units are in different positions in test.npz (e.g. test unit 0 has the firing profile of train unit 21 (~4.8/3.4 spikes per bin vs ~0.1), test unit 3 is silent like train unit 15, and test units 20, 21, 27 match train units 13, 11, 3). So a decoder trained on train/val does not transfer to test as-is. I fixed it by matching per-unit firing statistics and reordering the test columns (train unit<-test col: 0<-26, 3<-27, 11<-21, 13<-20, 15<-3, 17<-24, 19<-15, 20<-11, 21<-0, 24<-19, 26<-17, 27<-13). Labels in train/val agree with image_id, and I found no duplicate trials.
